contexts.text: They who attend little to the sense of a thing are they who belong to the cartilaginous and bony part of the external ear.
The things in man which have less life correspond to such Societies as are in less life; such things are the cuticles... also the cartilages and bones, which support all things in the body...
These Spirits relate to the scutiform cartilage... (These are the Spirits of the moon, AC 9236.) SE 3245.
